claude turn_end I finished slice gh-75/01 and reported it with `norn done done`. `norn run list` and `norn run view` now replace `norn trace` and `norn why`, and the full test suite (1206 tests) and the type check pass. - **Commands grouped under a noun:** a command can now be a noun with verbs, like `norn run list`. - `norn run` and `norn help run` list the verbs in order. - `norn help run view` and `norn run view --help` print the verb's usage and a list of its options. - `norn help` shows `run` as one row with its verbs in brackets. - `help --all` works and can hide a group of commands, but nothing is hidden yet; slice 14 decides which commands go there. - **`norn run list <unit>`:** this is the old `trace` moved to a new name, with the same flags, output and JSON. - **`norn run view <unit | run-id>`:** shows one run: step, attempt, outcome, times and duration, who, reason, and the paths to its receipts and logs. A unit key gives its latest run. - **`--why` and `--receipt`:** `--why` (with the old filter flags) prints exactly the JSON `why` printed. `--receipt <id>` also works without naming the unit, because norn finds the unit from the receipt. Using one of the `--why` filters without `--why` is a usage error. - **Old names:** `norn trace` and `norn why` now fail with exit 2, "Unknown command: …", pointing at `norn help`, and write nothing. All unknown commands now use that "Unknown command: …" message. - **Cockpit:** its trace key now runs `norn run list`. - **Tests:** the old trace and why tests were moved with their assertions, only the command calls renamed. New tests cover the verb listing and verb help, the removed names, `run view` by unit and by run id, a story with slices, and `--receipt` without a unit. - **Terminal check (AC8):** I built a story with recorded ticks using the test harness, ran the new commands and read the output; it reads correctly. Two things to be aware of: - **Old names still printed:** inbox items, hints and the handoff header still tell people to run `norn trace …` or `norn why …`, which now fail. The slice puts that rename in slice 14. - **`--why` prints JSON at the terminal:** that matches what `why` printed before, but it is the one `run` command that doesn't print readable text by default. **Friction:** a fresh worktree needed `bun install` before any test would run.
